feedback: Faithfulness is perfect as all generated content is grounded in the provided context with no hallucinations. Context coverage is hampered by the omission of several highly relevant topics present in the source material, most notably OpenAI's recall of ChatGPT Pro 20X due to capacity issues (a major product news item) and Cloudflare's new 'Disallow AI Training' setting.
